scenarios.scenario: Insight — Determine which projects are in the solution vs referenced
scenarios.reasoning: The agent did an excellent job analyzing the build failure, identifying the root cause (configuration mismatch due to missing solution configuration entry), and connecting all the pieces together. The only weakness is that it didn't fully enumerate all 42 projects individually, instead summarizing them. The investigation was methodical and efficient given the complexity of navigating a binlog file, and the final output provides clear, actionable information including suggested fixes.

rubricScores.criterion: Listed the projects that were built as part of the solution
Identified that LrgWindowsAppManifest was referenced but not included in the solution build
Noted the configuration (Debug vs Release) used for the missing project vs the referencing project
Connected the dots: project not in solution → builds with stale/wrong config → output in wrong path
